data.long_meaning: Aameen (أمين) is the Arabic amīn, 'trustworthy, faithful, honest, secure'. Written āmīn (آمين) it is also the word 'Amen' said at the end of prayer. Both senses are well attested; as a given name the sense is normally 'trustworthy'.

data.etymology: Arabic amīn, 'trustworthy', from the root ʾ-m-n; the prayer word āmīn is a homograph.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aameen total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aameen mean?
faq.a: Aameen means Trustworthy; faithful (amīn); also āmīn, 'Amen'.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aameen?
What language does the name Aameen come from?
faq.a: Aameen is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: Is Aameen a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aameen is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aameen written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aameen is written أمين in Arabic and امین in Urdu, and अमीन in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aameen?
faq.a: The root of Aameen is أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aameen?
faq.a: Arabic amīn, 'trustworthy', from the root ʾ-m-n; the prayer word āmīn is a homograph.

faq.q: Does Aameen appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; amīn, 'trustworthy', is Arabic vocabulary from the root ʾ-m-n, and āmīn is said in prayer.
Written āmīn (آمين) it is the word 'Amen' used in prayer; as a personal name Aameen is amīn (أمين), meaning 'trustworthy, faithful'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aameen?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aameen total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aameen?
faq.a: Aameen appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Amin, Ameen.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aameen?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aameen include Aamena, Aamal.
Amīn means 'trustworthy, faithful, honest, secure', from the Arabic root ʾ-m-n.

faq.q: Where is the name Aameen used today?
faq.a: Aameen is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
